source.name: Eni press release - Enilive becomes Serie A Title sponsor with sponsorship agreement up until 2027
source.quote: Enilive, Eni's company dedicated to mobility products and services, will be the Title sponsor of Serie A starting from the 2024/25 championship and covering three seasons.

note: Competition naming-rights deal reported at €22m per year (SportsPro, 2024-02-06); the Eni release states the term, not the value. Runs to the end of 2026-27 per the agreement 'up until 2027'.
